subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should doctor enforce the proposed 1 MiB AGENTS.md and 8 MiB root-memory limits and treat oversized or unreadable root-memory input as an archive-only repair?
rationale: The code shape is sound, but the exact limits and durable-memory recovery semantics are new product policy that cannot be inferred from an existing shipped contract.

options.title: Accept the proposed limits
options.body: Land the focused hardening with the tested thresholds and the archived file as the recovery path when a merge cannot be safely read.

options.title: Tune limits or reporting
options.body: Request a narrow revision to the thresholds or distinguish oversized files from other read failures before landing.

options.title: Use bounded streaming
options.body: Pause this patch and design a more complex bounded search or merge path that can process larger files without whole-file buffering.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed limits
recommendation.body: Land the focused hardening with the tested thresholds and the archived file as the recovery path when a merge cannot be safely read.
